name: Hugeicons
author: Hugeicons

sections.description:
Hugeicons plugin provides a seamless way to use Hugeicons in your WordPress site. This plugin is designed to make icon management and implementation as simple as possible.

Free Features:

  • Easy integration of Hugeicons into your WordPress site
  • Icon picker interface for block editors
  • Access to 4,300+ free icons
  • Shortcode support
  • Modern and responsive admin interface
  • Compatible with latest WordPress versions

Pro Features:
Upgrade to Pro to unlock:

  • Access to 40,000+ premium icons
  • Multiple icon styles (Solid, Duotone, Twotone, Stroke, Bulk)
  • Multiple icon sets to choose from
  • Regular updates with new icons
  • Priority support

Get Hugeicons Pro to unlock all premium features!

External Services

This plugin connects to Hugeicons’ servers for one essential purpose:

Icons API Service
* What: The plugin connects to https://hugeicons.com/api to fetch icon metadata and updates
* Why: This allows us to deliver real-time icon updates, new categories, and improvements without requiring frequent plugin updates
* When: Only when using the icon picker in the WordPress editor
* Data transmitted: Only technical requests for icon data; no personal information is sent

  • Terms of Service: https://hugeicons.com/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://hugeicons.com/privacy-policy

Support

For support, please visit:

  • Hugeicons Website
  • Documentation
  • Support

For premium support and features, upgrade to Pro!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/hugeicons directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings->Hugeicons screen to configure the plugin
  4. To unlock premium features, upgrade to Pro and enter your license key
sections.faq:
How do I add icons to my content?

You can add icons in several ways:

  1. Using the Icon Picker:

    • Click the Hugeicons button in your editor
    • Search and select your desired icon
    • Insert it into your content

  2. Using Shortcodes:
    [hugeicons icon=”icon-name” size=”32″ color=”#333333″]

  3. Using HTML:

What’s the difference between Free and Pro versions?

Free version includes:
* 4,300+ free icons
* Standard support

Pro version includes:
* 40,000+ premium icons
* Multiple icon styles
* Priority support

Upgrade to Pro to unlock all premium features!

How do I upgrade to Pro?

  1. Visit Hugeicons Pricing
  2. Choose your preferred plan
  3. Complete the purchase
  4. Download the pro add-on, install it and activate it
  5. Enter your license key in the plugin settings
  6. Refresh the page and you should see the pro icons in the icon picker

What are the system requirements?

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
